faces.name: Fumigate

steps.reason: Nothing counts what a Destroy instruction actually destroyed. Destroy carries no rememberAs/storeAs the way LoseLife, Discard, Mill and Sacrifice do, and no Amount reads a destruction, so the count would have to be a second copy of the Destroy's own selector - which reads the creatures present rather than the ones destroyed and counts indestructible survivors.
steps.text: You gain 1 life for each creature destroyed this way.
